chunks: 4492 - And Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Jafar عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who marries a woman upon giving her his slave and the slave's wife, and he delivered them to her. Then the slave's wife died while with the woman, and afterward he divorced her before consummating the marriage.

He عليه السلام said: "If he had appraised them for her on the day he married her at a stated value, then the second should also be appraised at a value. Then it is considered what remains from the first value upon which he married her, and the woman returns that to the husband. Then the husband gives her half of what came back to him from that."

key_terms.الزَّوْجِ: The husband, to whom part of the dowry value is returned before the final division.
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: The wife in the marriage contract; in one instance, also the slave's wife included in the property transfer.
key_terms.بِقِيمَةٍ: At a stated monetary value used for calculating the legal entitlement.
key_terms.طَلَّقَهَا: He divorced her, which triggers the legal ruling concerning half of the mahr before consummation.
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: A male slave given as part of the mahr.
key_terms.قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: Before consummation of the marriage, the stage at which only half of the mahr is due.
key_terms.قَوَّمَهَا: He appraised or assigned a monetary value to the dowry property.

ai.seo_question: How is the dowry calculated if part of it perishes before divorce and before consummation of marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a marriage dowry composed of a slave and the slave's wife, when one part of that dowry is lost before divorce and before consummation. The ruling requires financial valuation of the remaining property so that the wife returns the appropriate amount, after which the husband gives her half, in accordance with the rule of half-mahr before consummation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4492 - Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), who said:

I asked him about a man who married a woman on the basis of giving her his slave and the slave's wife, and he delivered them to her. Then the slave's wife died while in the possession of the woman, and afterward, he divorced her before consummating the marriage.

Imam (as) said: "If he had evaluated their worth for her at the time of the marriage, then the second (the slave) should also be evaluated. After that, the remaining value of the original dowry at the time of the marriage should be assessed, and the woman must return it to the husband. Then the husband must give her half of what remains from that value."
